issues.title: Original baseline forward and configuration are outside the runtime source binding
issues.details: The 59-entry source map binds the profiler, tracker and inherited training sources, but omits experiments/cadtrack/cadtrack.yaml, lib/config/cadtrack/config.py, the original CADTrack model factory/forward, backbone and head. The timing configuration and forward therefore are not bound by the profiler source guard. Local key baseline files match the historical latency review, so no actual source alteration is alleged. The gap is that the executable review contract does not attest those files on the measurement host.
issues.required_fix: Add the actually used original baseline configuration and model/forward dependencies to the existing source_sha256 map; refresh the plan hash and obtain a targeted re-review. No model, tracker or trainer behavior change is needed.

review_scope: Bounded fresh local source/interface, timing, ownership and hash-binding review; 59-entry map checked deterministically, not a new semantic audit of all inherited training files.

checkpoint_identity.details: Plan binds protected CADTrack_ep0014.pth.tar digest cbcc96ba3a0cf1bfb997ee164174c2264cabf17ad013f8249b7f31a43815d731, matching the copied-input receipt. It is checked before any stop signal. Original build uses training=False, then strict net load. No payload was opened by reviewer; runtime identity and total count remain unmeasured.

input_and_tracker_interface.details: read_pair concatenates registered RGB/TIR into HxWx6. Original crop preserves channels, PreprocessorMM produces 1x6xHxW, and original tracker receives a list of paired templates and one paired search. TrackerParams fields satisfy the constructor. YAML fixes search 256/factor4, template128/factor2, two paired templates and update every5 frames above0.65. Initial dataset box only; later boxes are not used.

original_stripped_forward.details: Separate RGB and TIR self-attention streams share the original backbone weights. Both template streams and search streams are forwarded; original decode fusion/head and online confidence/template update remain. The reviewed model/config files exactly match the historical baseline source hashes in ADOPTED_CANDIDATE_LATENCY_SOURCE_REVIEW.json.

ownership_and_isolation.details: Exact execution-report hash selects only the two GPU0 records: wrapper PIDs223759 and223760. startup verifies native RUNNING/PID/commands, actual wrapper and sole child cmdlines, CUDA device and run configuration. The profiler checks both UIDs, leader PGIDs and child group membership; GPU0 compute clients must equal the two child PIDs before pause. Launcher creates each wrapper with start_new_session=True and its subprocess child inherits that group. Only these group IDs are stopped/continued; no other GPU or host is signaled. Actual remote ownership and state are runtime checks, not observed by reviewer.

pause_lifecycle.details: Intentional stop region is inside try/finally; ordinary Python import, forward or assertion failures still reach SIGCONT of both verified groups. Resume state receipt is written and states must not remain stopped before COMPLETE is written. Execute in a detached registered native process so an SSH session failure does not terminate the pause owner. This source review does not attest uncatchable process termination recovery.

timing_and_statistics.details: Three named TRAIN sequences each initialize at0, warm frames1..20 and measure21..220 (600 total). Per-frame CUDA synchronization brackets wall time. End-to-end includes RGB/TIR read/decode; service includes crop, preprocess, network/head and template update but excludes decode. Initialization is separate. FPS is count/sum seconds; mean and P95 use measured frame latencies. All predicted boxes and recorded durations must be finite, durations positive. Other host jobs continue, so no matched Ours speedup is justified.

scope_and_ground_truth.details: No accuracy scorer, later GT, optimizer or trainable-parameter count is used. Total count enumerates all network.parameters and asserts103138437. This is only a600-frame TRAIN timing sample; no full benchmark/accuracy result or matched baseline-vs-Ours speedup exists. The provided72.4/72.74 baseline accuracy is not recomputed or independently verified.

hashes.details: All59 listed local source hashes and exact training execution digest match. Plan map omits baseline configuration and actual model/forward dependencies (B1). Manifest is absent locally; its expected digest matches the copied-input receipt and is enforced at runtime before pause.

syntax.details: Offline stdlib ast.parse(feature_version=(3,7)) passed profiler, launcher, native wrapper and original tracker without imports/execution, using installed uv-managed CPython3.13.12. Generic python alias failed with No pyvenv.cfg file before parsing; no environment was changed.

evaluation_type: real_gt initialization only; online latency sample, no accuracy evaluation
claim_ceiling: SOURCE_FAIL pending B1. Even a subsequent SOURCE_PASS establishes source readiness only, never measured FPS, actual parameter count, current process state or baseline accuracy.
